Subject: Kickoff: StrataBank access controls (SSO/SCIM/IPs/service accounts)

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. I wanted to kick off coordination for access controls ahead of our implementation sprint. Attaching a brief IP allowlist template (STRATACONFIPPOLICY.xlsx) and your SAML metadata placeholder (saml-metadata-stratabank.xml) to make the first pass easier.

Scope we plan to cover in the first two-week run:
- SSO (SAML): IdP metadata exchange, assertion attributes, SP vs IdP initiation
- SCIM v2 provisioning: user and group sync, attribute mapping, deprovisioning policy
- IP allowlist: egress and management-plane IPs for your firewall/VPN
- Service accounts: provisioning, least-privilege roles, and audit logging
- Org policies: role hierarchy, MFA enforcement, and session timeout defaults

Ask from you before our first technical call:
1) Okta (or IdP) admin contact and preferred test tenant (if available)
2) List of management and data-plane IP ranges to populate our template
3) SCIM fields you need populated (e.g., cost_center, departmentCode) or a sample CSV
4) Desired go-live date window (we typically do a 2-week pilot + cutover)

Can we schedule a 60-minute technical kickoff this week or early next? Proposing Wed 2026-09-16 10:00 AM PT — happy to move.

Next steps I’ll own: schedule call, share a MAP (mutual action plan) doc in Drive, and confirm test accounts.

—Sofia

Sofia —

Thanks for the clear outline. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- We run Okta Enterprise; Mark Ellis (cc) is our Okta admin and will join the call.
- We can provide management IP ranges but need to confirm whether you need outbound IPs for both control plane (console/API) and data plane (model endpoints).
- For SCIM, we expect user provisioning + group membership sync. We will default to deprovision-by-disable (so SCIM should set active=false on removal).
- Preferred start window: target pilot week of Oct 5, but we can do kickoff calls earlier to align.

Quick Q: Do you require SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flows for our initial test? We typically prefer SP-initiated for SSO flows with external vendors.

I can do Wed 2026-09-16 11:00 AM ET (which is 08:00 PT). Does that work?

—Elaine

Subject: Re: Kickoff: StrataBank access controls (SSO/SCIM/IPs/service accounts) — technical notes

Elaine / Mark —

Quick technical notes ahead of the call:
- SP-initiated is our preferred pattern for first pass (simpler for pilot flows). We support IdP-initiated as well for production cutover.
- SCIM: Redwood implements SCIM v2.0 with a small set of optional custom attributes. If you can share the mapping for cost_center and departmentCode we will pre-seed those fields. Our default deprovisioning sets active=false.
- IPs: we need two sets: (1) console/control-plane egress (for UI/API calls) and (2) inference endpoint egress (if you plan to host model calls behind your firewall). Put those in the attached template.
- Service accounts: recommend a dedicated service account per environment (staging/prod) with scoped roles and key rotation every 90 days. We will expose audit logs to your SIEM via a log-forwarding endpoint (configurable).

Attached: small internal checklist (inline) — I'll bring details to Wed's call.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
